summary: CryptPad is a self-hosted office suite designed for real-time document collaboration and synchronisation. It allows multiple users to edit documents simultaneously while keeping data synchronised across sessions.
goodFor: Teams requiring collaborative office tools who need to self-host their infrastructure under an open source licence.
watchOut: You will need to evaluate how well its feature set and document formats meet your specific workflow requirements compared to more established office suites.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application packaged with Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
